checks.name: S3 buckets exposed to the public
Security groups open to the internet

findings.title: Inline policy grants every action on every resource
findings.detail: Inline policy 'medtech-assessment-developer-policy' allows Action '*' on Resource '*'. MFA: NO, active access keys: 0.
findings.remediation: Delete the inline policy and grant only the actions the job needs, through a group or role.
findings.key: IAM-ADMIN|iam:user/medtech-assessment-developer|Inline policy grants every action on every resource

findings.title: Database is publicly accessible
findings.detail: PubliclyAccessible is true, so the endpoint resolves to a public IP.
findings.remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible to false and move the instance to private subnets.

findings.title: AdministratorAccess is attached directly to a user
findings.detail: Long-lived user credentials carry full admin rights. MFA: NO, active access keys: 1.
findings.remediation: Move admin rights to a role assumed with MFA and remove the user's access keys.
findings.key: IAM-ADMIN|iam:user/medtech-assessment-admin|AdministratorAccess is attached directly to a user

findings.title: Database storage is not encrypted
findings.detail: StorageEncrypted is false, so data and snapshots sit unencrypted.
findings.remediation: Snapshot the instance, copy the snapshot with a KMS key, and restore from the encrypted copy.

findings.title: SSH (22) is open to the internet
findings.detail: Inbound rule allows 0.0.0.0/0 to reach admin port 22.
findings.remediation: Restrict the source to the corporate IP range, or remove the rule and use SSM Session Manager.
findings.key: SG-OPEN|sg-30826841278ab9dd9 (medtech-assessment-web-sg)|SSH (22) is open to the internet

findings.title: CloudTrail trail has audit logging gaps
findings.detail: Gaps: covers one region only; log file validation is off; logs are not encrypted with a KMS key; not delivered to CloudWatch Logs, so no alerting.
findings.remediation: Make the trail multi-region, enable log file validation and KMS encryption, and send it to CloudWatch Logs.
